Ys.bar_b_note: Noisy neon-green camouflage pattern breaks up the silhouette and hides the face, short of Palworld's clean creature reads.

Wb.bar_b_note: Strong serpent silhouette with a vivid blue/pink palette and a readable swimming role carried it.

Rn.bar_b_note: Thin, small silhouette and a faint end barely different from standing undersell it.

My.bar_b_note: Grounded fur-and-shell bear with a clear curl-up faint and ridden role reads at Palworld finish.

Pc.bar_b_note: Dark olive body with low value against the stage makes silhouette and face hard to read.

Gt.bar_b_note: Faint poses look the same as standing, so the hurt/faint read fails despite a decent model.

Qk.bar_b_note: Interesting moss-horse identity, sunk by a contorted, broken-looking faint-mid neck.

Tu.bar_b_note: Clean teal otter silhouette with a clear ridden role and readable faint carried it.

Wz.bar_b_note: Small moth whose faint frames barely change from standing and whose pale body merges with the stage.

Rm.bar_b_note: Solid teal finned lizard with a readable faint, though plain in material.

Cu.bar_b_note: Appealing stylised elder with clear eyes and an earthy palette that fits the key art, though more cartoon than the creatures.

Ng.bar_b_note: Boar shorter than the trainer: A floats in faint mid, B is a smooth clay toy, both below the naturalistic fur bar.

Ni.bar_b_note: Dark, flat rainy backdrop with a plain panel, and B's tiny truncated text, fall short of Palworld UI finish.

Up.bar_b_note: Naturalistic moss-backed hare with a readable silhouette and faint carried it.

To.bar_b_note: A lone thin panel in an otherwise sparse meadow, with B's blown-out white card, does not match Palworld base-building finish.

top_changes.change: Author distinct, grounded hurt/faint poses for creatures whose faint reads like standing (Gt, Wz, Rn, Qk) and pin faint bodies to the ground (Ng A)
Rework creature materials toward the naturalistic fur/scale bar with readable values (Ys camo noise, Pc dark olive, Ng B clay)
Ship Side A's large-text craft panel layout and Side A's framed, capped, stone-footed wall, with textured rather than flat infill
